description: Find apps that integrate a given SDK. Pass one or more SDK ids via `sdk` (e.g. "google-ads-admob"). Useful for competitive/market-share analysis of ad networks, analytics, and other SDKs. Example: fortytwo_apps_by_sdk({ platform: "android", sdk: "google-ads-admob", limit: 20, _apiKey: "your-token" })

_apiKey.description: 42matters API access token (get one at https://42matters.com/pricing).

platform.description: App store to query: "android" (Google Play) or "ios" (Apple App Store). Defaults to "android".

sdk.description: SDK id, or comma-separated SDK ids, to match (apps embedding ANY of them). e.g. "google-ads-admob", "facebook-sdk".

name: fortytwo_apps_by_sdk
